prompt: When an operator on an access or frontage road is entering an access-controlled highway, who must yield?

options.text: Vehicles on the highway must slow down to allow the entering driver entry
The entering driver yields to vehicles already on the highway or exiting
Vehicles on both roads must stop completely and alternate entry order
Whichever vehicle is traveling faster has automatic legal right-of-way
